description: Sunlit windows at the sites, pads and rover legs of the Connecting Ridge pack, hourly 2028-2031 (writer tools/illumination/sun_link.py; reader lunarsim/illumination.py). Windows: [s0, l0, g1, l1, ...] hour indices, start0 = s0, end0 = start0 + l0 (exclusive), start1 = end0 + g1; hour i covers [i, i + 1) from time.start_utc.

criteria.any_part: some of the solar disc above the local horizon (f > 0)
criteria.half: at least half of the solar disc above the local horizon (f >= 0.5)
criteria.full: the whole solar disc above the local horizon (f >= 0.999)

leg_rules.worst: every route sample of the leg lit (its worst sample)
leg_rules.most: at least 80 % of the leg's route samples lit (a rover crosses short shadows on its battery)

glaser.source: Gläser et al. (Connecting Ridge, average illumination at 2 m and 10 m above ground; 3-5 days of continuous darkness), as cited in research_notes/Lunar communications and visibility/earth_visibility_prior_art.md

best_point_2p5m.note: the best-lit site or route sample of the pack at 2.5 m; Gläser's figure is the ridge's best point

avgvisib.note: the map: mean visible solar-disc fraction at the surface (LDEM 60 m) over its own period (label); ours: 2028-2031 hourly; the map's way = surface level on the 5 m tile averaged to 60 m

provenance.dem_near: 5 m tile of the terrain pack (LOLA 5 m, PGDA 78)
provenance.ephemeris: SPICE spkcpo SUN from BASE, LT+S, MOON_ME (kernels as tools/comms)
provenance.flags: Sun position Spec (SPICE); terrain Measured (LOLA); observer height 2.5 m Assumed; night = below half the disc Assumed
